Container.Name: lsyncd-webui
Container.Overview: Main server side of lsyncd-webui. Watches the folders you pick and mirrors every change to the backup server within seconds, or syncs both ways for folders you choose, with a web UI for progress, folder selection, excludes and file counts on both servers.

Config.Name: Shares (read only)
Config.Description: Folders you can choose from in the web UI. Read only: the main server is never changed.

Config.Name: Shares (read-write, two-way folders)
Config.Description: Only used for folders you set to two-way: changes made on the backup are written back here. Mirrored folders are never written.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port of the web UI (host network).

Config.Name: Web UI password
Config.Description: Optional. When set, the web UI asks for it (any user name).
